title: Spaghetti Carbonara
summary: A classic Italian pasta dish with eggs, cheese, bacon, and black pepper.
instructions: Boil pasta. Cook bacon. Mix eggs and cheese. Combine off heat. Season and serve.

title: Chicken Tikka Masala
summary: Chunks of grilled chicken (tikka) cooked in a smooth buttery & creamy tomato based gravy.
instructions: Marinate chicken. Grill. Simmer onion and tomato. Add cream. Add chicken and simmer.

title: Greek Salad
summary: A refreshing salad with tomatoes, cucumbers, olives, and feta cheese.
instructions: Chop vegetables. Combine in a bowl. Add feta. Dress with olive oil and lemon.
